overview.purpose_zh: 这张图把五款笔记本的价格、重量、续航、性能和屏幕尺寸放在同一张图里，每项指标一根竖轴，每一款机型是一条贯穿五根轴的折线，用来比较多维规格和取舍。
works_zh: 比较四到八个指标的多款产品，尤其是笔记本、手机、相机这类规格表
看出某款产品在哪些指标上领先、在哪些指标上让步
把不同单位的数据放进同一张图里看整体取舍
uses_zh: 选购笔记本时对比几款候选机型
产品评测里的规格总览
把竞品参数放在一页里讲清楚

understanding.read_zh: 从左到右依次读五根轴：价格、重量、续航、性能、屏幕。价格和重量两根轴做了反转，越靠上表示越便宜、越轻；其余三根轴越靠上表示数值越大。先单独看每一根轴上的高低，再顺着一条线看它如何从一根轴走到下一根轴；两条线交叉，说明两款机型在相邻两项指标之间的排序发生了对调。这种图第一次看容易乱，讲给别人听时要先交代每根轴的方向和哪两根轴做了反转，再指出线在哪里交叉。

elements.note_zh: 每根轴代表一个指标，轴顶和轴底是这五款机型在该指标上的最大值和最小值。
一条线就是一款机型，线在每根轴上的高低是它在这项指标上的位置。
价格和重量被反转：越靠上越便宜、越轻，而不是数值越大。
两条线交换高低，说明两款机型在这两项指标之间的取舍正好相反。

look_for_zh: 先看被高亮的 Air 13 从最左走到最右：便宜、轻，但性能和屏幕都垫底。
在续航和性能两根轴之间找交叉：轻薄的机型在这里从上面掉到下面，厚重的机型反过来。
注意价格轴的单位是十美元，轴上的 159 不是 159 美元，读数时要乘以十。
轴上的最高最低是这五款之间的相对位置，不代表整个市场的标准。

observations.en: Air 13 is the cheapest and lightest model here, at 159 on the price axis and 1.24 kilograms, but it also has the lowest performance score at 72.
observations.zh: Air 13 在这里最便宜也最轻，价格轴上是 159，重量 1.24 千克，但性能分数只有 72，是五款里最低的。

observations.en: Ultra 16 sits at the other end: 389 on price, 2.14 kilograms and the highest performance at 97, with the shortest battery life at 14 hours.
observations.zh: Ultra 16 站在另一端：价格 389、重量 2.14 千克、性能 97 最高，但续航只有 14 小时，是最短的。

observations.en: Between the battery and performance axes, the lines cross: the light, cheap models lose their lead on performance, while the heavy, expensive ones move to the top.
observations.zh: 在续航和性能两根轴之间，几条线互相交叉：轻薄便宜的机型在这里失去领先，厚重昂贵的机型反而升到顶部。

observations.en: Mini 14 lasts longest at 20 hours, yet costs 199 and scores 78 on performance, so it trades speed for endurance.
observations.zh: Mini 14 的续航最长，达到 20 小时，价格 199、性能 78，用速度换来了耐用。

observations.en: Air 13 and Ultra 16 are the two extremes: one weighs 1.24 kilograms with a performance score of 72, the other weighs 2.14 with 97.
observations.zh: Air 13 和 Ultra 16 是两个极端：一个重 1.24 千克、性能 72，另一个重 2.14 千克、性能 97。

describe.en: The parallel coordinates chart compares five laptop models across price, weight, battery life, performance and screen size.
describe.zh: 这张平行坐标图从价格、重量、续航、性能和屏幕尺寸五个方面比较五款笔记本。
describe.pattern: The chart compares A across B
alternatives: The chart puts five metrics side by side for five models.
Five models are compared on five metrics in one view.
describe.note_zh: 开头先说明是哪几个指标、几个对象；平行坐标图不适合一上来就念数字。

describe.en: On performance, Pro 14 at 91 is higher than Studio 15 at 85, but both trail Ultra 16 at 97.
describe.zh: 性能上，Pro 14 的 91 高于 Studio 15 的 85，但都落后于 Ultra 16 的 97。
alternatives: Pro 14 scores 91 for performance, above Studio 15 at 85.
Studio 15's 85 is lower than Pro 14's 91 on performance.
describe.note_zh: higher than 只比两个数；三者一起说时用 but both trail，句子更紧凑。

describe.en: Overall, the chart is a trade-off: the light, cheap models win on price, weight and battery, while the heavy, expensive ones win on performance and screen.
describe.zh: 总体来看，这张图讲的是一种取舍：轻薄便宜的机型在价格、重量和续航上占优，厚重昂贵的机型则在性能和屏幕上占优。
alternatives: Overall, what you gain in portability you lose in power.
In general, the models split into light and powerful camps.
describe.note_zh: 概括一句“取舍”，不要把每根轴都念一遍。

describe.en: The three most expensive models, Ultra 16, Pro 14 and Studio 15, score 97, 91 and 85 on performance respectively.
describe.zh: 最贵的三款 Ultra 16、Pro 14 和 Studio 15 的性能分数分别是 97、91 和 85。
describe.pattern: A and B + verb + X and Y + respectively
alternatives: Performance falls from 97 on Ultra 16 to 91 on Pro 14 and 85 on Studio 15.
Ultra 16 leads on performance with 97, followed by Pro 14 at 91.
describe.note_zh: respectively 让三组数字和三个型号一一对应，顺序绝对不能乱。

describe.en: Battery life ranges between 14 hours on Ultra 16 and 20 hours on Mini 14.
describe.zh: 续航在 Ultra 16 的 14 小时和 Mini 14 的 20 小时之间。
alternatives: Battery life sits between 14 and 20 hours.
The shortest battery life is 14 hours; the longest is 20.
describe.note_zh: between ... and ... 报区间，and 不能换成 to。

describe.en: Price and performance move together here: the two most expensive models, Ultra 16 and Pro 14, also post the two highest performance scores.
describe.zh: 这里价格和性能同向变化：最贵的两款 Ultra 16 和 Pro 14，性能分数也正好是最高的两个。
alternatives: Higher prices come with higher performance in this data.
The expensive models also score best on performance.
describe.note_zh: move together 只描述同向变化，不说明价格高导致性能好。

describe.en: Ultra 16 costs more than twice as much as Air 13 on the price axis, 389 against 159.
describe.zh: Ultra 16 在价格轴上是 389，Air 13 是 159，前者是后者的两倍多。
describe.pattern: A + be + twice as much as + B
alternatives: Ultra 16's 389 is more than twice Air 13's 159.
Air 13 costs 159, while Ultra 16 costs 389, more than double.
describe.note_zh: 389 和 159 都是轴上的原始读数（单位是十美元），直接比较倍数没问题。

describe.en: Ultra 16 reaches its highest point on the performance axis at 97 and its lowest on the battery axis at 14.
describe.zh: Ultra 16 在性能轴上达到最高点 97，在续航轴上落到最低点 14。
describe.pattern: reach its highest point + at + value
alternatives: The performance axis peaks at 97 with Ultra 16.
describe.note_zh: 平行坐标没有时间轴，这里的“最高点”指某根轴上的位置，不是趋势。

describe.en: The gap in battery life is small: Mini 14's 20 hours is only slightly longer than Air 13's 18.
describe.zh: 续航的差距不大：Mini 14 的 20 小时只比 Air 13 的 18 小时略长。
alternatives: Battery life differs only slightly, from 14 to 20 hours.
Mini 14 lasts 20 hours, slightly more than Air 13 at 18.
describe.note_zh: 两小时的差距在 14 到 20 这一档里确实只算小幅；别把每个差距都写成 significantly。

academic.en: Figure: parallel coordinates chart of five laptop models on five metrics. The axes run from price and weight, both inverted, through battery life to performance and screen size. Air 13 records 159 on the price axis and 1.24 kilograms, the lowest values in both cases, together with 18 hours of battery life. Ultra 16 sits at the opposite end: 389 on price, 2.14 kilograms, 14 hours and a performance score of 97. Between these two extremes, Pro 14 and Studio 15 sit in the middle on most axes, while Mini 14 leans toward Air 13 on price and weight but has the longest battery life. The most visible change in ordering occurs between the battery and performance axes, where the lighter, cheaper models fall from the upper part of the chart to the lower part.
academic.zh: 图：五款笔记本在五项指标上的平行坐标图。五根轴依次为价格、重量（前两根为反转轴）、续航、性能和屏幕尺寸。Air 13 在价格轴上的读数是 159，重量为 1.24 千克，两项都是最低值，续航为 18 小时。Ultra 16 位于另一端：价格 389、重量 2.14 千克、续航 14 小时，性能分数 97。在这两个极端之间，Pro 14 和 Studio 15 在多数轴上处于中段，Mini 14 则在价格和重量上靠近 Air 13，但续航最长。排序上最明显的变化出现在续航轴和性能轴之间：更轻、更便宜的机型从图的上方落到下方。

business.en: For buyers, the chart makes the trade-off easy to see: Air 13 and Mini 14 keep the price low and the weight down, and they also deliver the two longest battery lives, at 18 and 20 hours. That combination suits people who carry a laptop to work every day and rarely run heavy software. Ultra 16 and Pro 14 go the other way: at 389 and 299 on the price axis, they buy the top two performance scores, 97 and 91, and larger screens. The business decision is therefore about hours of use, not about finding one model that wins everywhere. A sales team that travels will feel the 2.14 kilograms of Ultra 16; a design team will feel the 72 performance score of Air 13.
business.zh: 对买家来说，这张图把取舍摆得很清楚：Air 13 和 Mini 14 把价格和重量都压得很低，续航还是最长的两个，分别为 18 和 20 小时。这样的组合适合每天背着电脑通勤、很少跑重软件的人。Ultra 16 和 Pro 14 走的是另一条路：价格轴上 389 和 299，换来最高的两个性能分数 97 和 91，屏幕也更大。所以购买决策的关键是用机时间，而不是找一款处处都赢的机型。经常出差的销售会感受到 Ultra 16 的 2.14 千克；设计团队则会感受到 Air 13 只有 72 的性能分数。

simple.en: Five laptops, five things to compare. The Air 13 is the cheapest and the lightest, and its battery lasts 18 hours. The Mini 14 lasts even longer, at 20 hours. Both are easy to carry, but they are not fast: their performance scores are 72 and 78. If you edit video or run big programs, look at the Ultra 16. It scores 97, but it is heavy at 2.14 kilograms and lasts only 14 hours. One warning: the price axis counts in tens of dollars, so 159 is not 159 dollars.
simple.zh: 五款笔记本，五个可以比较的方面。Air 13 最便宜也最轻，续航 18 小时。Mini 14 的续航更长，有 20 小时。两款都好带，但都不快：性能分数分别是 72 和 78。如果你要剪视频或跑大型软件，就看 Ultra 16。它的性能分数是 97，但重 2.14 千克，续航只有 14 小时。还有一点要小心：价格轴的单位是十美元，159 不是 159 美元。

language_notes.body_zh: 价格和重量两根轴故意倒了方向：越靠上表示越便宜、越轻。读的时候先在轴顶确认单位，再把“高”翻译成“好”。如果不看反转，就会把 Ultra 16 在价格轴上的最低位置误读成最便宜，其实它是最贵的。
examples: Air 13 sits at the top of the inverted price axis because 159 is the lowest price.
Ultra 16 sits at the bottom of the weight axis because 2.14 kilograms is the heaviest.

language_notes.body_zh: 两条线交叉只说明两款机型在相邻两个指标上的排序变了，不代表数据有问题。比如 Air 13 在续航轴上比 Ultra 16 高，到了性能轴却落到它下面。写句子时用 while 或 whereas 把这种对调讲清楚，比逐个报数字更有信息量。
examples: Air 13 leads on battery life, while Ultra 16 leads on performance.
The lines cross between battery and performance because the two models trade one strength for the other.

language_notes.body_zh: 平行坐标图把五个不同单位的指标并排放在一起。159 是价格轴上的读数，1.24 是重量，18 是续航小时数，72 是性能分，这些数字之间不能直接比较大小，只能在同一根轴上比高低。
examples: Air 13 scores 72 on performance and 18 on battery; the two numbers are not on the same scale.
Read 159 against the other prices, not against the battery hours.
